description.text: This is a fine-tuned version of [Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct) trained on the [VQA-RAD](https://huggingface.co/datasets/flaviagiammarino/vqa-rad) radiology visual question answering dataset using **QLoRA**. The LoRA adapter weights have been **merged into the base model**, so no PEFT dependency is required at inference time.

serving.notes: max_new_tokens 32 is the card example. temperature 1e-6, do_sample true, and repetition_penalty 1.05 are generation_config.json. text_config.max_position_embeddings and generation max_length are 128000. The example requires an image. Vision encoder was frozen; only language layers were adapted. Per-device batch is 1, gradient accumulation 4, effective batch 4. Training max sequence length 512. Hub safetensors total is 3,754,622,976 F16 parameters. There is no adapter_config.json. The Hub API still sets library_name peft and base_model:adapter. The line 'trained 2x faster with Unsloth' is library boilerplate and was not used as method evidence. The Unsloth GitHub link is that library badge, not a training repo for this checkpoint. Cited papers do not print this repo id. The model card says 2,248 question-answer pairs; the dataset page says 2,244 after dropping 4 duplicate triplets, with 1,793 train and 451 test.

evaluation_reported.text: On the official test split (451 samples): exact match 53.88% (base model 48.12%), token F1 58.43%. Closed-ended exact match 77.29%. Open-ended exact match 24.50%, token F1 34.75%.

discrepancies: QLoRA and flaviagiammarino/vqa-rad match the inventory. The YAML and the details table say the parent is Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct, which matches the inventory. The Unsloth footer on the same card says Finetuned from model: unsloth/Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct.
